messages:
anya: Heads-up — I'm piloting a lightweight request-gating + obfuscation flow at the router for PII-ish spans before anything hits the inspect console. Goal: reduce noisy sampled scrubs while keeping inspect useful. thoughts?

mike: Short + clear. Failure modes? FP obfuscation that confuses devs? :thinking_face:

anya: Yep that's the main worry. My idea: soft-gate = obfuscate in telemetry/inspect and attach a tag. If classifier confidence < threshold, keep full text but mark for sampling/QA.

jordan: How do we measure quality — what telemetry do we emit?

anya: Plan: emit obfuscation_count, obfuscation_rate (per-route), sample_flagged_count, and an FP_estimate metric baked from periodic labeling jobs. Also keep small example buffer (4-8 examples) per route for the console.

sam: Will this change model I/O or billing? We need parity guarantees.

lee: Also quota interactions — if we gate at router, are we changing token accounting?

anya: We do NOT touch live payloads to models — only the logging/inspect streams. Token/billing parity remains unchanged. Obfuscation is exclusively for telemetry/log viewing.

mike: Rollout proposal: default off, tenant opt-in flag + console toggle, plus an API header for devs to request obfuscation in their logs. Gradual canary.

anya: Example route config I'm thinking of:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "obfuscation": {
    "mode": "soft",
    "confidence_threshold": 0.85,
    "sample_if_lt": 0.6,
    "emit_metrics": ["obfuscation_count","sampled_false_pos"]
  }
}
```

jordan: Important: embeddings customers — even if we only obfuscate logs, examples shown in console could mislead model-eval comparisons. We should include a clear badge: "Examples are obfuscated for telemetry".

sam: UI idea: per-route histogram of obfuscation_rate over time + a small examples panel with toggle: "Show obfuscated examples / Request raw audit (breakglass)". Raw audit should create an auditable job that is tenant-scoped and requires approval.

lee: Ops: add alerting when obfuscation_rate spikes >3x baseline or when FP_estimate exceeds X. Also rate-limit unmask requests to prevent abuse.

mike: For QA we should have a synthetic canary test that injects common PII patterns and asserts detection TPR >= 0.9 on canary hosts before enabling.

anya: Agreed. Ownership suggestions: infra owns router hook + metrics emit; devex owns console examples and wording; privacy/legal to sign off on breakglass flow.

jordan: Metric names proposal (stable): redacted.telemetry.obfuscations, redacted.telemetry.samples_flagged, redacted.telemetry.fp_estimate. Dashboards: per-route heatmap + top-10 example snippets (obfuscated).

sam: Ops note: we should persist examples in ephemeral store TTL=7d and rotate keys; audit trail for unmask requests.

mike: One more: add SDK header X-Redwood-Obfuscate:{on|off|auto} so customers can opt in for their own dev environments.

anya: Great — next steps: I'll sketch an RFC w/ rollout phases + dashboard mock and assign owners. If no blockers, start canary dev week after next.

oncall-bot: Runbook stub created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/obfuscation (created by anya) :white_check_mark:

anya: Thanks all — will ping when RFC is up.
